dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hello. Can I speak to Nam, please?
dialogue.reading: həˈloʊ. kən aɪ ˈspiːk tə ˈnɑːm, ˈpliːz?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: This is Mr. Brown, her English teacher.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɪs ɪz ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn, hɜːr ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˌtiːtʃər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh, hello! Nam! Mr. Brown is calling!
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, həˈloʊ! ˈnɑːm! ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn ɪz ˈkɔːlɪŋ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hello, Mr. Brown. This is Nam.
dialogue.reading: həˈloʊ, ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn. ˈðɪs ɪz ˈnɑːm.
